summary: The PlacementCommentsArchive is a web user control designed to display and manage comments, alerts, and conditions related to placement requests. It interacts with resources, user sessions, and conditions within the HSPnet application framework.
purpose: The primary purpose of PlacementCommentsArchive is to set up and display various types of comments and alerts (such as comment alert, condition alert, and urgent alert) related to a placement request within the HSPnet system. It ensures that users are notified appropriately based on the conditions and alert settings associated with the placement.

workflows.name: SetupComments
steps: Set comment alert text based on ShowCommentAlert flag.
Retrieve and display condition description if ConditionCodeID is set.
Set condition alert text based on ShowConditionAlert flag.
Set urgent alert text based on ShowUrgentAlert flag.

business_rules: If ShowCommentAlert is true, display 'Yes' next to the comment alert label.
If ConditionCodeID is not zero, retrieve the condition description from the code database.
Display a note about email notification if there are conditions and ShowConditionAlert is true.
If ShowUrgentAlert is true, display 'Yes' next to the urgent alert label.
validations: ValidationSummary1 control is used to display validation messages.
system_behavior: Display alerts and comments based on flags and conditions.
Render condition and comment sections depending on the presence of data and settings.
